# units

Typed lengths and other measures. Every length a kit function takes is a `units.*` value, never a bare number.

Every example below is a complete script that passes the kit's checks; the kit's tests run each one.

- [`units.mm`](#unitsmm): A length in millimetres.
- [`units.m`](#unitsm): A length in metres.
- [`units.in`](#unitsin): A length in inches.
- [`units.ft`](#unitsft): A length in feet.
- [`units.of`](#unitsof): A quantity of any kind in any unit the unit library knows (an airflow, a load, a pressure).
- [`units.in_`](#unitsin_): A measure's value in a unit (`units.in_(width, "in")` is 24 for a 24 in width).

## units.mm

A length in millimetres.

```ts
mm(value: number): Measure
```

Topics: units, metric, millimetre

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.mm(0), y: units.mm(0) }, { x: units.mm(6000), y: units.mm(0) }], thickness: units.mm(200) });
  },
});
```

</details>

## units.of

A quantity of any kind in any unit the unit library knows (an airflow, a load, a pressure).

```ts
of(kind: string, value: number, unit: string): Measure
```

Topics: units, airflow, cfm, quantity

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const tall = units.of("length", 3, "m");
    building.walls(ctx, { level: "L1", points: [{ x: units.m(0), y: units.m(0) }, { x: units.m(5), y: units.m(0) }], thickness: units.mm(150), height: tall });
  },
});
```

</details>

## units.in_

A measure's value in a unit (`units.in_(width, "in")` is 24 for a 24 in width).

```ts
in_(m: Measure, unit: string): number
```

Topics: units, convert, number

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, checks } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "part",
  reads: {},
  parameters: { width: { type: "quantity", kind: "length", unit: "in", label: "Width", default: units.in(24) } },
  run(ctx, v) {
    const inches = Math.round(units.in_(v.width, "in"));
    const b = parts.part("Box", { type: `${inches}`, category: "generic" });
    b.box({ length: v.width, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    ctx.parts.define("acme.box." + inches, b.build());
  },
});
```

</details>
